The expression is \(\lceil (3.6)^2 \rceil - ( \lceil 3.6 \rceil ) ^2\).

First, compute \((3.6)^2 = 12.96\).  
The ceiling of \(12.96\) is \(\lceil 12.96 \rceil = 13\).

Next, compute \(\lceil 3.6 \rceil = 4\).  
Then square it: \(( \lceil 3.6 \rceil )^2 = 4^2 = 16\).

Finally, subtract: \(13 - 16 = -3\).

Answer: -3
